name: context-meter
description: How full your context is, against the model's window, as a bar at the bottom right, green up to a limit you choose and red past it.

limitTokens.title: Context limit (tokens)
limitTokens.description: Leave empty to measure against the model's whole context window. Set a smaller size to keep the context under it, even if your model allows more: the bar fills up to it, green to 30%, orange to 80%, red after.
